messages:
Asha Patel: quick sync — Kite pilot cohort: 5 accounts enrolled, 2 still pending final SSO. need to confirm enablement workshop slots this week.
Miguel Torres: copying the list here: https://tiny.example.com/kite-pilot - can we do slots Tue/Wed 60m?
Priya Rao: Tue afternoon works for eng to join. can we request SAML metadata earlier pls? we had one customer stuck because SP entity was wrong.
Samir Khan: noted. I'll ping the two pending customers now. timeline risk for renewals if we miss production cutoff (we've flagged 30% renewal risk in CLM)
Asha Patel: ack. renewal risk flagged against acct IDs KITE-112 & KITE-117. do we want a targeted enablement + exec touch from customer success?
Nora Li: yes — suggest 30m exec intro + 60m enablement. i'll draft invite language. :thumbsup:
Miguel Torres: FYI, eng can prepare a quick integration checklist. sample snippet below to share with customers:
```
Required items:
 - SAML metadata (entityID, ACS URL)
 - API key whitelist IPs: 34.78.12.0/24
 - Test dataset (s3 link) for inference runtime profiling
```
Priya Rao: also add a short regression test set (5 prompts) so we can run quality checks after migration.
Asha Patel: please add a feedback cadence: post-workshop survey after 24h and a 2-week check-in. I'm proposing this survey (short):
```
1) How easy was the integration? (1-5)
2) Any outages or auth failures? (free text)
3) Did latency meet your needs? (Yes/No)
4) How likely to renew? (1-5)
5) Additional comments
```
Samir Khan: can we hook survey results into Gainsight? i'll create webhook + small lambda to push events.
Miguel Torres: I can provide a cURL to post from workshop host:
```
curl -X POST https://hooks.example.com/survey -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"acct":"KITE-112","q1":4,"q5":"overall good"}'
```
Nora Li: draft invite done, sent to Asha for review. will include exec intro and enablement agenda.
Asha Patel: thanks — action items:
 - Samir: outreach to two pending SSO customers (today)
 - Priya: test-suite + regression prompts (EOD Wed)
 - Miguel: integration checklist + cURL example (tomorrow)
 - Nora: send invites and exec intro (ASAP)
I'll follow up in 48h with status. pilot-bot: calendar reminder set for Tue 2024-09-03 15:00 UTC. :calendar:
pilot-bot: thread archived after 7d of inactivity.
